ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes setup and cleanup time (price list). The hall has 8-hour, 12-hour and 24-hour rates; the 24-hour rates (regular rate ①, Mon-Wed, tax included) are 8,745,000 yen for the Entire Hall, 5,258,000 yen for Hall A and 4,433,000 yen for Hall B (updated July 3, 2026). Night-time or 24-hour use may not be available depending on the bookings before and after, so consult in advance. Except for some areas, the venue can be used 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Advance arrival of packages is in principle specified as arrival on the day before the event, and an advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date (valuables are not accepted, and the venue is not responsible for damage to packages). Large or numerous packages that were not notified in advance are treated as renting the venue as a storage space, for a fee. (Source: Hall price list updated July 3, 2026; FAQ; Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 20)
ops.loadingHours: When there is load-in or load-out, an advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date (the loading area cannot be used if it is not submitted). Delivery vehicles for load-in and load-out must enter and leave from the designated place within the usage time, and the venue may adjust load-in times and the like. The Event Hall has 7 loading bays on B2 (loading bay numbers No.5 to 11), and 4-ton trucks can pull up directly to the load-in entrance. The load-in door is a double door, 2,830 mm wide x 3,450 mm high; the load-in elevator has an entrance door of 850 mm wide x 2,080 mm high, a car interior of 1,600 mm wide x 2,000 mm high x 2,300 mm deep, and a load capacity of 1,000 kg. The permitted dimensions of the loading area are 3,600 mm total height x 9,000 mm total length (4-ton long trucks or smaller). For the 1F conference rooms, unloading is done at the roadside, and the load-in door is 2,350 mm high x 1,730 mm wide. The on-site manager completes entry procedures at the Bellesalle reception on B2F before starting work. The building entrance is open on weekdays 7:00-21:00 and on Sat, Sun & holidays 7:00-19:30. Packages received in advance are in principle limited to 5 boxes for the hall and 2 boxes per room. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice; Event Hall Equipment List updated September 30, 2026; 1F Conference Room Equipment List updated September 8, 2026; official facility page; Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 16)
ops.vehicleRules: The loading area is used only for loading and unloading; if parking is needed, use an outside parking lot. When multiple vehicles are used, they share one vehicle's loading space in staggered turns. Illegal parking, parking anywhere other than the designated parking lot, and roadside parking around the building are strictly prohibited. Products, packing materials, decoration materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period. If delivery vehicle traffic is expected to be congested, traffic staff are placed at the entrance and similar places. Vehicle restrictions in the equipment lists: the Event Hall is 3,600 mm high x 9,000 mm long x 2,450 mm wide and 4.0 t (long trucks or smaller); the 1F conference rooms accept up to 2-ton trucks. When it becomes congested during Event Hall use, the Terms of Use request that traffic guards be placed at the intersection in front of the venue. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice; Event Hall Equipment List updated September 30, 2026; 1F Conference Room Equipment List updated September 8, 2026; Terms of Use 2026ver2 Articles 15, 16 and 21)
ops.parking: The parking field of the equipment lists says "none" for Bellesalle-exclusive parking, hourly parking and drop-off area, for both the Event Hall and the 1F conference rooms. To find nearby hourly parking lots, search for "Bellesalle Takadanobaba" on "s-park" (Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation), which is linked from the official facility page. (Source: Official facility page; Event Hall Equipment List updated September 30, 2026; 1F Conference Room Equipment List updated September 8, 2026)
ops.waitingRooms: The B2 Event Hall has 2 dressing rooms and 2 waiting rooms (Dressing Room A 41㎡, Dressing Room B 38㎡, Waiting Room A 30㎡, Waiting Room B 23㎡). All have a usage fee of 0 yen, a private restroom and a refrigerator. Dressing Room A has 8 dressing tables and Dressing Room B has 7, and Dressing Rooms A and B also have a hot-water space. The waiting room field for the 1F conference rooms is "none". (Source: Official facility page; Event Hall Equipment List updated September 30, 2026; 1F Conference Room Equipment List updated September 8, 2026)
ops.catering: Outside food/drink brought in is allowed. However, if a caterer other than the operator's designated vendors is used, an "outside food/drink fee" applies (party use only; bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered). The amount depends on venue area: up to 300㎡ 100,000 yen, up to 600㎡ 200,000 yen, up to 900㎡ 300,000 yen, up to 1,200㎡ 400,000 yen, 1,201㎡ and above 500,000 yen (110,000 to 550,000 yen each, tax included). The Event Hall has water supply and drainage facilities, so it can be used for food-related events and for hosting guests. Party menus for receptions are introduced on the website of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company. (Source: Outside Food/Drink Fee Guide PDF; FAQ; official facility page; Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 4)
ops.restaurants: For receptions, the official website introduces the party menu of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company (see the menu section of their website for details). (Source: FAQ)
